responsibility: Implements the backward jump-threading passes that search paths from a final conditional or switch back through predecessors. It uses ranger/path-range reasoning to resolve taken edges, path profitability heuristics to control duplication and loop interactions, a registry of candidate threading paths, and separate early/normal/full pass variants that differ in speed/size mode and whether unknown SSA values are resolved with the ranger before CFG updates are delegated to the threading update machinery.
